In v7.1.2, fgetl() accepts line_sz bytes into caller buffers allocated at exactly HCBUFSIZ_LARGE, then writes line_buf[line_len] = 0 with line_len == line_sz, producing the advisory's one-byte heap out-of-bounds write. CVE-2026-68767 is PUBLISHED and GHSA-vgv2-whp7-2895 is not withdrawn.
